title: The Emergence of Social Science of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review and narrative synthesis of existing literature examining how LLMs reproduce human stereotypes, implicit associations, and biased moral judgments.
Systematic review and narrative synthesis of studies that probe LLMs for consistent political preferences and ideological leanings.
Qualitative assessment contrasting peer-reviewed and preprint studies, and reflecting on the implications of restricting the review to English-language publications.
